verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs describe real-time capture of every session/trace/span, alerting on live logs, and distilled 'Luna' models that monitor 100% of production traffic at lower cost, which directly supports continuous evaluator execution on live traffic (not just offline datasets), complemented by custom/LLM-as-judge metrics and datasets built from live production data. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that evaluators run continuously in production (all evidence is vendor docs) and clearer detail on evaluator scheduling/latency at scale.
